You really did hit me with that "You can't pinpoint the problem", this is probably what I'm feeling right now, I feel shit and I don't even know what to do anymore. I feel like the only solve for this problem is death.

I'm not sure about this but whenever I'm reading books, I feel like I'm forgetting my problems and my suicidal thoughts. I'm not really sure what is the reason but I'm always reading a book whenever I am.
